pageTitle: Klacks compared | Open source vs. SaaS staff scheduling
hero.title: Klacks vs. conventional staff scheduling
hero.subtitle: Why installation on your own premises (on-premises), open source and freedom of choice in AI make all the difference — an honest comparison.
table.rows.ki: AI assistant with a free choice of models
details.title: The differences in detail
details.items.0.title: Hosting: on your own premises (on-premises) vs. cloud
details.items.0.text: Klacks runs on your own infrastructure via Docker. With a local AI model, HR data never leaves your premises. SaaS solutions store data on their own servers, often in the US. Switching to another provider with SaaS is a complex process (data export, migration).
details.items.1.title: License: open source vs. proprietary
details.items.1.text: Klacks can be used under the AGPL-3.0 without license fees — no subscription, no per-employee charges. You can view the code, customise it and host it yourself; anyone who makes a modified version available to others via a network must disclose its source code. SaaS providers are proprietary: you pay a monthly fee per employee and have no control over the code.
details.items.2.title: AI assistant: model selection vs. black box
details.items.2.text: Klacksy supports 7+ providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, DeepSeek, local models). The admin chooses — no lock-in. Most SaaS providers have no AI scheduling or rely on a proprietary black box that cannot be replaced.
details.items.3.title: Languages: 25 vs. limited
details.items.3.text: Klacks supports 25 languages (4 core + 21 plugins). SaaS solutions typically offer 2–8 languages. This makes Klacks significantly more flexible for international teams.
details.items.4.title: Compliance: 30+ countries pre-configured
details.items.4.text: Klacks comes with public holiday calendars and working time regulations for 30 countries. Most SaaS providers only cover the DACH region or DACH+EN. Customisable rule parameters (29+) allow for industry-specific adjustments.
details.items.5.title: Industries: 6 templates + custom
details.items.5.text: Klacks provides templates for home care, hospitals, security, facilities management, logistics and the hotel and catering industries. With Klacksy, you can also configure any industry you like (29+ parameters). SaaS solutions are usually generic.
honest.title: What Klacks can’t do (honestly)
honest.intro: We’re not exaggerating. Here are the limits of Klacks:
honest.items.0: No biometrics or fingerprint recognition — Klacks plans based on qualifications and availability, not on biometric presence.
honest.items.1: No live GPS tracking — Klacks optimises routes proactively, but does not track staff locations in real time.
honest.items.2: No time clock / kiosk / NFC terminal — Klacks is about planning, not time recording.
honest.items.3: No proper payroll accounting — Klacks exports formatted data (e.g. DATEV), but does not process payroll.
honest.items.4: Compliance warnings, no hard block — Klacks issues warnings in the event of breaches of working time regulations, but does not block saving (except in the case of a General Council veto).
cta.title: Want to see for yourself?
cta.text: Download Klacks, launch Docker, and see the difference for yourself. No registration, no license fees.
